## Lane
Feature

## Anchor
F26#0, ACCEPTANCE §6.2 and CODEX_START_HERE F26 at main c7cb265b54: Forward+ renders the village, Crossing Hall and four biomes with their required materials, while Compatibility remains selectable as Low. Archive the remaining material censuses and independent strict review; close this one criterion to bring the board to 109/280. Gameplay and shipping renderer settings retain main's source, including the night rim. F26#3 full visual quality and F26#5 Ally/default promotion stay open.

## Evidence
| Criterion or invariant | Named test or ordinary-play witness | Expected | Observed on commit/package |
|---|---|---|---|
| F26#0 Forward+ material path | f26-material-census-5f4093ad54; retained f26-mini-batch-ff0395-0620 | Named production scenes render with required mounted material families | Water, Meadows and Cloudreach native exit 0 at 5f4093ad54; retained Stormwood native exit 0 at 0620d57b. Final independent audit validates required samplers, GPU maps, source continuity and original images. |
| F26#0 Low remains selectable | Retained water-low-r1, meadows-low-hall-r2 and graphics-settings-final | Actual Compatibility routes and persisted Low choice | Reused passing production Settings and gl_compatibility route receipts; unchanged preference/renderer source. |
| Acceptance accounting | Independent strict-f26-0-full-access-review.txt, raw SHA256 b95f2d9ef4917d60e2b7f3f637df821f8aaf4b018bc5eb550829bfff7744909e | Exactly one criterion gains credit | F26#0 strict MET; 109/280 on this cut, every other criterion unchanged. |

Runs stage catalogue state, time and camera and use debug teleport on an isolated desktop profile. Mounted-resource coverage and original images establish this material-path criterion; they do not establish earned campaign, multiplayer, every culled pixel, full visual quality, Ally performance or renderer-default promotion. Original failures/warnings and the reviewer's superseded provisional alias audit remain archived. The day images do not certify main's night appearance.

RD-36/RD-37: reuse these passing captures and source-equivalent Low evidence. No repeated unit suite or automatic full-ci label; the only new executable tool is the already exercised census driver, and engine proof remains scoped to the recorded captures.
